mathematics.color: Replicate input at right/bottom odd boundaries; sum RGB over scale x scale, apply exact rational coefficients, add chroma 128, nearest-even once, clip to [0,255]. Y scale 1; Cb/Cr requested sampling 1 or 2.
mathematics.transform: Replicate component edges to complete 8x8 blocks. Standard orthonormal DCT-II of samples minus 128. DC is exactly sum/8. Quantization nearest integer, exact DC halves away from zero.
mathematics.coefficient_gate: Every emitted coefficient and every GPU probe coefficient must agree exactly; every color byte must equal independent integer model. Every DC must match independent integer nearest/ties-away reference. Every AC must satisfy abs(coefficient*quant - independent float64 DCT) <= quant/2 + absolute_DCT_error_budget.
mathematics.scope: Project mathematical approximation budget, not ISO/T.83 certification. Float64 oracle error must be cross-checked on adversarial blocks with higher precision.
mathematics.MCU_padding: Encode all interleaved MCU slots. Outside ceil(component_width/8) x ceil(component_height/8), all 64 quantized coefficients are zero. Independent entropy decode must check absolute DC after prediction and every AC for these dummy blocks.
mathematics.oracle_precision_gate: 80-digit Decimal cosine/DCT versus float64 on nine adversarial 8x8 blocks: max absolute difference <= 1e-9.

scope: Current 68 original resize products; complete RGB input to entropy output mathematics, strict framing, unchanged whole-image CPU quality. Progressive output/metadata/full GPU decode remain outside this subset; no old-versus-old JPEG comparison.
